**Chief Information Officer (CIO)**

**The C.W. Williams Community Health Center, Inc.**  
**Department:** Information Technology  
**Reports to:** Chief Executive Officer (CEO)  
**Classification:** Exempt  
**Schedule:** Full-Time, 40 hours per week

**Lead Technology. Advance Healthcare. Strengthen Our Community.**

Th C.W. Williams Community Health Center is seeking an experienced, strategic, and **hands-on Chief Information Officer (CIO)** to lead our information technology and information systems strategy and operations.

The CIO will ensure that technology, data, cybersecurity, and digital health solutions support high-quality, accessible, equitable healthcare. This leader will partner with clinical and administrative leadership while also providing **direct, hands-on technology support to employees at all levels of the organization**.

This is an opportunity for a healthcare technology leader who can move comfortably between **executive-level strategy and day-to-day IT problem solving**. The successful candidate will be willing to roll up their sleeves, troubleshoot issues, assist employees directly, and ensure that technology works effectively for both clinical and administrative teams.

**Strategic & Hands-On IT Leadership**

* Develop and execute a multi-year **IT and digital health strategy** aligned with organizational goals and growth.
* Lead technology modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
* Partner with the CEO and executive leadership on technology strategy, investments, risks, and opportunities.
* Provide **hands-on IT support and troubleshooting to employees at all levels**, including executives, providers, clinical staff, administrative staff, and support teams.
* Diagnose and resolve issues involving **desktops, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, software, connectivity, user access, and other technology systems**.
* Respond to employee technology needs in a timely, professional, and service-oriented manner.
* Assist employees with technology questions, system navigation, basic troubleshooting, and appropriate use of IT resources.
* Step in and perform technical work when needed rather than relying solely on delegation or outside vendors.
* Evaluate emerging healthcare technologies and recommend solutions that improve patient care and organizational performance.
* Lead change management and promote adoption of new technologies across the organization.

* Establish appropriate standards for system availability, performance, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Monitor technology issues and ensure timely resolution of system outages and service interruptions.

**Healthcare Technology & Digital Health**

* Lead optimization of the **electronic health record (EHR)** and related clinical systems.
* Oversee implementation and optimization of **telehealth, remote patient monitoring, patient portals, population health analytics, and digital engagement tools**.
* Identify technology solutions that improve access to care and reduce barriers for underserved populations.
* Support technology initiatives related to behavioral health, social determinants of health, patient self-management, language access, and community outreach.

**Data & Analytics**

* Establish effective processes for data collection, integration, reporting, analysis, and visualization.
* Use data to support clinical outcomes, quality improvement, operational performance, patient experience, and organizational decision-making.
* Partner with leadership to develop meaningful dashboards, reports, and performance metrics.
* Ensure appropriate data governance, integrity, availability, and security.

**Cybersecurity, Privacy & Compliance**

* Develop and maintain a strong **healthcare cybersecurity program**.
* Oversee risk assessments, security monitoring, incident response, access controls, security policies, and employee cybersecurity training.

**Job Description**
-------------------

***Join Hilo Benioff Medical Center and be part of a team that proudly cares for our friends, family, and neighbors across East Hawaiʻi.***

Hilo Benioff Medical Center is seeking an experienced Regional Director of ITl Services to lead and oversee technology operations across the East Hawaii Region. This is a fully on-site position based in Hilo, Hawaii, responsible for ensuring reliable, secure, and high-performing information technology (IT) services that support clinical care, patient safety, and business operations. This position reports to the Regional Chief Information Officer and supports regional facilities including Ka’u Hospital, Honoka’a Hospital, East Hawaii Health Clinics and Yukio Okutsu State Veterans Home, playing a critical role in advancing technology capabilities that directly impact patient care and operational excellence.

The IT Director will also drive strategic initiatives, including infrastructure modernization, cybersecurity, and service excellence in a complex healthcare environment.

The East Hawaii Region recently transitioned to Epic as the organization’s electronic health record (EHR) system. This position works in collaboration with the EHR Director who owns Epic application strategy, build, optimization, training, and application support. The IT Director owns the technical platform and operational services that Epic depends on in addition to the technology services required for the facilities.

* Lead region-wide IT operations, including team of 20+ Regional End User Support professionals
* Ensure high availability and performance of infrastructure including networks, servers, storage, and clinical systems.
* Own IT operational policies and runbooks to include patching, vulnerability management, change windows, maintenance communications, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Develop and manage IT operating and capital budgets; prioritize investments that improve clinical reliability and reduce downtime risk.
* Manage vendor contracts, MSPs, telecom, device vendors, and support agreements with measurable SLAs.

* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive IT experience, demonstrating increasing scope and accountability across core IT functions (e.g., infrastructure, end-user computing, service management, security, or clinical systems support).
* Minimum of five (5) years of leadership experience managing medium to large scale IT operations teams of 15 or more employees in a 24/7, mission-critical environment, with responsibility for service delivery, incident escalation, staffing/on-call coverage, and operational performance. Prior leadership experience should be at the Director or Executive level, or equivalent.
* Healthcare experience strongly preferred, particularly in acute care settings; experience in other high-reliability environments may also be considered.

**Technical Expertise:**

* Strong proficiency in network and wireless operations
* Experience with server/virtualization and storage systems
* Expertise in endpoint management, including imaging, patching, encryption, and EDR tools

**Certifications:**

* Relevant IT certifications (e.g., ITIL, Microsoft, Cisco, or security certifications) preferred but not required.
* Epic certification also strongly preferred.

**The Opportunity**
===================

**Ascension Property Services** is a fast-growing, acquisition-built platform of skilled-trades operating companies spanning electrical, mechanical, plumbing, and property services. The platform currently comprises roughly 20 operating companies and approximately 1,500 employees across multiple offices and field locations and continues to grow through acquisition. Day-to-day IT services are delivered by the Company's managed services provider (MSP).

The **Director of Information Technology** is the Company's internal IT leader, reporting to the Chief Financial Officer. The role owns the technology function for the platform: managing the MSP relationship and holding it to its service levels; integrating newly acquired and legacy operating companies onto the Company's standard IT platform; and owning the cybersecurity program that protects the enterprise from phishing, business email compromise, and payment fraud. This is a high-visibility position within the Office of the CFO, with regular exposure to executive leadership, the private-equity sponsor's deal team, and lenders.

**Position Summary**
====================

* Serve as the Company's internal owner of information technology: set IT strategy, standards, budget, and priorities across the platform.
* Manage the MSP relationship: govern service levels (SLAs), performance, and cost, and hold the provider accountable for reliable, high-quality service to the Company and all operating companies.
* Integrate new and legacy operating companies onto the Company's standard IT platform, systems, and controls.
* Own cybersecurity and risk: establish the controls and safety net that protect the business from phishing, social engineering, and payment/wire fraud.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Managed Services Provider (MSP) Management and Service Delivery**

* Own the relationship with the Company's managed services provider (MSP) as the internal executive accountable for IT service delivery across all operating companies.
* Define, govern, and enforce service levels (SLAs), response and resolution targets, escalation paths, and performance reporting; hold the MSP accountable to the contracted standards.
* Review and approve the MSP scope, service catalog, and pricing; manage the contract, renewals, and change orders; ensure the Company receives the service it is paying for.
* Run regular service reviews with the MSP; monitor ticket volumes, uptime, response times, and end-user satisfaction; and report performance to leadership.
* Serve as the escalation point for major incidents and service failures; drive root-cause resolution and corrective-action plans.
* Ensure MSP delivery is standardized and consistent across all sites and newly acquired operating companies.

* **Operating-Company Onboarding and Platform Integration (M&A)**

* Own IT integration for newly acquired operating companies: current-state assessment, cutover planning, and migration onto the Company's standard platform (identity, email, network, endpoints, and business systems), directing the MSP as the delivery resource.
* Develop a repeatable IT integration playbook with Day-1 / Day-30 / Day-90 checklists to accelerate onboarding and reduce integration risk.
* Consolidate and standardize disparate legacy domains, email tenants, applications, and toolsets onto common platforms; retire redundant infrastructure and licenses.
* Standardize identity and access management (single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, role-based access) across every operating company.
* Partner with corporate development, finance, and operating-company leadership on IT diligence input, integration timelines, and transition-services-agreement (TSA) exit.

* **Cybersecurity, Risk, and Fraud Prevention**

* Own the enterprise cybersecurity program and ensure appropriate, consistent controls across all operating companies, whether delivered internally or through the MSP.
* Direct email security and anti-phishing controls; run continuous phishing simulations and mandatory security-awareness training for all employees.
* **Prevent payment fraud:** implement controls against business email compromise (BEC), wire / ACH fraud, and vendor or banking-detail change fraud, working with finance and accounts payable on verification, call-back, and dual-control procedures.
* Ensure endpoint detection and response (EDR), multi-factor authentication, patch management, least-privilege access, and secure backup and disaster recovery are in place, and validate that the MSP is delivering them.
* Establish incident-response and business-continuity plans; run tabletop exercises; define breach escalation and notification protocols.
* Align the program to a recognized framework (for example, NIST CSF or CIS Controls); manage cyber-insurance requirements, vendor risk (including the MSP's own security posture), and periodic security assessments.
* Provide clear, periodic risk and posture reporting to the CFO, executive leadership, the sponsor deal team, and the Board.

* **Infrastructure, Networks, and End-User Computing**

* Oversee, through the MSP, the network, connectivity, cloud, and telephony across headquarters, branch offices, and distributed field / job-site locations.
* Ensure reliable management of the endpoint and mobile-device fleet and field technology, and dependable connectivity for a mobile, field-based workforce.
* Ensure backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity for business-critical systems.

* **Applications, Data, and Business Systems**

* Support and rationalize core business applications (accounting, project management, payroll / HRIS, service dispatch, and estimating).
* Partner with finance and operations on system consolidation, reporting, and data integrity across operating companies.
* Support the data-governance and reporting needs of the Office of the CFO.
